semantic_manifest.quantifiers: standard class definitions and reductions must be curated before proof promotion
semantic_manifest.asymptotic_model: polynomial-time asymptotics; exact model still requires curator capsule
semantic_manifest.computational_model: standard complexity model; do not substitute an opaque proposition
assumptions: The formal target must preserve the intended definitions of P, NP, reductions, and completeness.
A proof assistant acceptance is not semantic fidelity evidence by itself.
semantic_manifest.conclusion: Target equivalence remains unpromoted until the official statement and formal target are semantically aligned.

conceptual_frame.statement: A shared representation of order, relations, and certificates may reduce search and verification cost across cultural, research, and mathematical projects.

search_policies.description: Probe short structured candidates with explicit expanded cost and cheap exact falsifiers.
Mutate assumptions and representations around recorded failures without erasing their scope.
Explore a high representation-distance route only after ordinary candidates produce information.
Request semantic target review before any result can be promoted as a theorem candidate.

cross_domain_relations.meaning: Visual and symbolic ordering hypotheses are first-class candidate inputs.
Rejected routes remain searchable memory with scope and mutation axes.
Relations and visual invariants can expose representation choices without becoming theorem evidence.
Every mathematical move retains source, status, validator, and uncertainty.
Proofs and counterexamples stay behind trusted verifier references.

provenance.producer: MAK source-learning bridge and math-kernel MVP
